# Code of Conduct

## Our Commitment

We want this project to be open, respectful, and useful for everyone.

Participants are expected to:

- Be respectful and professional.
- Assume good intent and communicate clearly.
- Welcome constructive feedback.
- Focus on what is best for the project and community.

## Unacceptable Behavior

Examples of unacceptable behavior include:

- Harassment, discrimination, or personal attacks.
- Trolling, insulting, or derogatory comments.
- Publishing private information without permission.
- Any conduct that creates an unsafe environment.

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies to project spaces, including:

- GitHub issues and pull requests.
- Project discussions and reviews.
- Any official communication channels for this repository.

## Reporting

If you experience or witness unacceptable behavior, report it to the maintainers privately.

When reporting, include:

- What happened.
- Links or references.
- Date/time and context.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may remove, edit, or reject content and contributions that violate this Code of Conduct.

Depending on severity, actions may include warning, temporary restriction, or permanent ban from project spaces.
